name: Dynamic links
description: Provides the ability to create links that combine several links into one.
project_description:
This module provides the ability to create links that combine several other links and redirect the user to the first available link. This can be useful for sites where users have multiple roles and the home page or menu links need to redirect the user based on access.

 Supporting this Module ☕ 
 Found this module useful? Support via PayPal. 

 Features 
 Provides the ability to create links that combine several links into one.

 
 You can create any number of links. 
 Links are stored as a configuration entity. 
 You can also use subrequest mode instead of redirection. Then the content of the available link will be displayed without redirection. 
 
 Post-Installation 
 After installation, go to /admin/structure/dynamic-link/add , fill out the form and save.
